title: How Cebuanos can help make Cebu more liveable
summary: Rappler joins the Cebu Citizens Initiative to learn more about how Cebuanos can help make Cebu more liveable

blocks.text: Rappler joins the Cebu Citizens Initiative to learn more about how Cebuanos can help make Cebu more liveable

CEBU, Philippines – Cebu’s intricate watershed systems are deeply connected to its flooding problems. Consequently, this affects Cebu’s liveability and how citizens can recover from weather-induced disasters.
Rappler joins the Cebu Citizens Initiative on a hike along one of Cebu’s major waterways to learn more about how Cebuanos can actively take part in making the province more liveable. – Rappler.com
